messages:
emily: Draft announce post and benchmark narrative uploaded (private draft). Need quick engineering + docs + sales sanity check: exact changelog lines, canonical docs URL, canary timing, and UTMs before we lock embargo. Can everyone pls review here? :eyes:
kevin: Paste the changelog snippet and proposed canary schedule here. Also confirm whether we should explicitly call out Dedicated vs Hosted behavior in the public post.
emily: Draft staging doc: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/announce/apr-release-2026-draft.md
emily: Proposed short changelog TL;DR for top of page: "Staged canary rollout with automatic lightweight fallback to preserve latency under load. See docs for full rollout policy and metrics."
tara: I can publish to /docs/release-notes once copy is final. Please include a 1-line TL;DR for the top. ETA publishing tonight if text locked.
samir: Suggested changelog snippet (ok for public): ```- rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~48h
- fallback: automatic to `quant-lite` when error_rate or p95 latency thresholds breach
- policy_id: release-apr-2026-canary
```
samir: Canary schedule (eng tentative): start Tue 04/14 00:00 UTC at 10% to variant `v6-quant-lite`, hold 6h, ramp to 50% Wed 04/15 08:00 UTC, full by Thu 04/16 02:00 UTC if green. Rollback target: `v5-stable` and automatic fallback to `v5-stable` on token-error spike.
diane: Sales ops: need UTMs + SFDC queue mapping for webinar/reg form. Proposed UTMs: utm_campaign=apr_release_2026&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email. For paid ads add utm_term=paid; set lead_priority=high for paid traffic. SFDC queue: inbound-ml-evangelists; product_tag=AprRelease26.
emily: Webinar slot we're planning: Wed 04/15 16:00 PT. Slides + speaker list in the staging doc.
kevin: Eng ok to call out Dedicated briefly. Recommended one-liner: "Dedicated customers retain pinned capacity by default; Hosted customers get automatic fallbacks unless opted out." Keep it short in public copy. We'll add the policy id in the docs.
tara: :thumbsup: I'll publish at 18:00 PT and paste canonical /docs link here. Will add TL;DR and the product one-liner.
diane: :thumbsup: SFDC mapping queued once final UTMs confirm. We'll create the form webhook and SDR routing.
release-bot: Canary job scheduled: name=apr-2026-release-canary, variant=v6-quant-lite, initial_traffic=10%, monitor_url=/ops/releases/apr-2026
emily: Marketing needs final go/no-go by EOD so we can set embargo lift time (planned Thu 04/16 09:00 PT). Please react with :thumbsup: when your lane is green or reply with blockers.
kevin: :thumbsup: Eng confirms schedule and wording. Will attach policy id to product notes and notify SRE for monitoring windows.
tara: :thumbsup: Docs publishing on my watch, will post link here when live.
diane: :thumbsup: Sales ops ready to wire SFDC/UTM mapping.
emily: Thanks all  for quick turn here. I'll update the announce draft with the staging changelog and swap in the canonical links once Tara posts them. :rocket:
